common.tagline: Volcanic homeworld of the Sullustans and SoroSuub Corporation.
common.government: SoroSuub Corporation (effective rule); Sullustan Council in title
common.climate: Volcanic; survivable in subsurface cavern cities
common.famousFor: SoroSuub starship and blaster manufacturing. The greatest underground cities in the Outer Rim.
common.cantinaReputation: Volcanic world riddled with underground cities. The SoroSuub Corporation runs everything — fuel, weapons, ship components. If you can afford their prices and dodge the Imperial inspectors, Sullust is the best place in the sector to refit a ship. Massive lava tube networks make excellent hiding spots.
